page.layout: One page of text, with a woodcut ornament and title block at the top, followed by two paragraphs of running text. No marginal notes. Faint show-through from the reverse side in the right half is not transcribed.

main_text.head: SYSTEMATIS POLITICI PRÆCOGNITA; De fine & obiecto status Politici.
main_text.p: ABsoluimus hactenus per Dei gratiam praecepta Prudentiae Ethicae & Oeconomicae, id est, eius quae pertinet ad beatitudinem priuatam vel singulorum hominum separatim spectatorum, vel societatis domesticae, quae Oeconomica dicitur: restat inter partes philosophiae practicae, ut loco postrema, ita dignitate prima, Prudentia nempe Po-litica, per quam publicus & maior hominum coetus, siue societas ad publicam beatitudinem dirigitur.

Non est difficile agnoscere qualis & quam arcta connexio sit inter tres istas Philosophiae Practicae partes, nempe inter Ethicam, Oeconomicam, & Politicam; nam ut felicitas siue beatitudo ciuilis est vel Priuata vel Publica, & Priuata iterum vel vnius hominis separatim spectata, vel paucorum hominum in vna domo confocia-

page.notes: The title line and first paragraph are italic in the scan where marked; the title block is set in roman capitals and small capitals. The page number at the top is a small mark and uncertain. The pencil-like mark "A 9" at the foot is handwriting, not a printed signature, and is omitted. Show-through text from the reverse side is omitted. Spelling of u/v and i/j normalised as instructed.
